ownerApproval.provenance: Direct human approval reported by requesting owner chat; no fabricated message identity. The original request asked for a draft handoff, not an immediate build.

canonicalCopy.method: Decode canonical UTF-8, normalize CRLF and CR to LF, remove YAML frontmatter only, append the complete unchanged body after the canonical-copy marker in the adapter. No trimming or rewriting. Raw source SHA-256 pins refer to immutable original bytes, not normalized adapter bytes.
canonicalCopy.relativeLinks: Resolve copied canonical body links relative to the original canonical specification directory; test-slice links relative to the original test slice.

statusMeaning: Adapter draft only; build-auto owns future story status. No Auto Run Result or executed coverage is claimed.
sourcePriority: Current supplied AGENTS owner decisions, approved written DESIGN/EXPERIENCE and detailed annex; immutable canonical AC/state/test/applicability IDs preserved. Reuse 35.2 foundation/font/login approval only; no inherited completion or runtime evidence.
historicalAdmissionMeaning: Dated preparation, not operative approval. Later operative approval and exact allocation supersede only the approval/allocation gates; source snapshots and historical candidate identity remain unchanged.
